disclaimer: SYNTHETIC validation of the harness/pipeline. NOT empirical calibration. Gate C is NOT complete. Posts and outcomes were authored for offline testing; they are not observed X impressions.
scenario: Small tech-niche account (~2k followers) over a consistent 24h observation window. Numbers are invented, not measured.
seed_note: Corpus is checked in, not sampled. Backtest inference uses a deterministic seed and the heuristic path by default.

posts.text: Shipped a local eval harness that scores LLM traces in 12ms p95 on a 16GB laptop. Repo + repro script in the thread. No GPU required.
Cut cold-start from 1.8s to 210ms by pre-warming the tokenizer and pinning the vocab mmap. Before/after traces attached. Same model, same prompts.
Open-sourced the JSONL fixture loader we use for ranking-score diffs. Deterministic seeds, checked-in golden files, MIT. PRs welcome if you add a failing case first.
Postmortem: our nightly eval silently dropped 40% of rows because a UTF-8 BOM snuck into one shard. Tests passed. The metric lie lasted 11 days. Checklist we added is in the replies.
CVE write-up (low): our upload path trusted the client MIME type. Magic-byte check now rejects mismatched PNG/JPEG/MP4. No known exploit in the wild. Patch in v0.4.2.
Minimal pytest pattern for a seeded Monte Carlo: freeze numpy Generator(seed), assert p10<=p50<=p90, and compare the visualized run to median exposure—not the first run.
If you ship ranking weights from a public repo, do you pin the commit SHA in the scorecard or only in a comment? Genuinely curious what survives a six-month replay.
sqlite WAL vs a tiny Postgres for a single-node sim store: we kept SQLite. Replay hashes and owner isolation were cheaper than a queue. Tradeoff notes in the next post.
Rewrote the trace joiner in Rust. Python stayed in charge of I/O. Throughput 4.6x on a 2.1M-row fixture; peak RSS down 31%. No unsafe. Criterion benches in /benches.
Unpopular: leaderboards without a frozen prompt set and a disclosed seed are just vibes. If I cannot replay your eval, I do not care about your 2-point gain.
Audience sim loop: extract features → persona affinities → map onto impression priors → RankingScorer weights → candidate-slate competition → cascade. Groq never emits the headline score.
Weekend project: a 120-line watcher that fails CI if any committed scorecard still says empirically calibrated. Ugly. Effective. gist in replies.
Looking for one contractor to review our replay hashes and SQLite snapshot contract. Paid, small, public write-up at the end. DM a failing test, not a resume.
v0.5.0: independent action marginals, stored-probability replay, confidence stays 0.0 until a real holdout exists. Full notes in CHANGELOG. No new niches.
If you only adopt one eval habit this month: dump the exact command line, seed, and SHA of the fixture into the report JSON. Future you will not remember the flags.
Been thinking a lot about AI tooling lately. The space is moving so fast. More thoughts soon.

A ranking score is not a forecast. Public default weights scale predicted action probabilities, then apply an offset and an out-of-network factor. They do not know your followers, your history, or tonight's experiments. Treat the number as a comparative scenario.
Hot take: if your product needs a 70B judge to tell two hooks apart, you do not have an eval. You have a mood ring with extra latency.
Tried to reproduce a viral '12x faster RAG' gist. Their benchmark used cached embeddings and counted the cache as inference. Uncached it was 0.9x. Always print cache hit rate.
